description: This file defines the UserService interface, which provides methods for managing User entities such as finding, creating, updating, and deleting users within the application.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Interface for user-related operations within the domain branch of the application.

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User object based on the provided user ID.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the system with the given User object.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates details of an existing user with the provided User object.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes the user identified by the given user ID.
